calculated_fields.name: Total AUM
calculated_fields.description: Assets Under Management across all products

calculated_fields.name: Delinquency Bucket
calculated_fields.formula: IF [Overdue Days] = 0 THEN 'Current' ELSEIF [Overdue Days] < 30 THEN '1-29 DPD' ELSEIF [Overdue Days] < 60 THEN '30-59 DPD' ELSEIF [Overdue Days] < 90 THEN '60-89 DPD' ELSE '90+ DPD (NPL)' END
calculated_fields.description: Days Past Due aging bucket classification

calculated_fields.name: Credit Utilization %
calculated_fields.formula: IF [Total Credit Limit] > 0 THEN [Total Credit Outstanding] / [Total Credit Limit] * 100 ELSE 0 END

calculated_fields.name: Customer Risk Category
calculated_fields.formula: IF [Composite Risk Score] >= 50 THEN 'Critical' ELSEIF [Composite Risk Score] >= 35 THEN 'High' ELSEIF [Composite Risk Score] >= 20 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END
calculated_fields.description: Risk tier classification based on composite score

calculated_fields.name: Engagement Health
calculated_fields.formula: IF [Engagement Status] = 'ACTIVE' THEN 'Healthy' ELSEIF [Engagement Status] = 'DECLINING' THEN 'At Risk' ELSEIF [Engagement Status] = 'DORMANT' THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Stable' END
